review.tagline: SDKs for running AI-generated code in isolated cloud sandboxes
review.summary: E2B provides JavaScript and Python SDKs that start isolated cloud sandboxes and run shell commands inside them. Companion packages add a Code Interpreter (runCode/run_code) and a Desktop SDK for mouse, keyboard and screenshot control. The runtime can be self-hosted with Terraform on AWS, GCP, Azure or a generic Linux machine; the hosted service needs an API key.
review.audience: Developers who need sandboxed code execution for agents or app builders
strengths: Official JavaScript/TypeScript and Python SDKs with a matching sandbox API
Separate Code Interpreter and Desktop SDKs cover code execution and computer use
Self-hosting supported on AWS, GCP, Azure and generic Linux via Terraform
Apache-2.0 license; cookbook repo has examples for several LLMs and frameworks
weaknesses: Hosted use requires an E2B account and API key
Self-hosted runtime lives in a separate repo, e2b-dev/runtime
README gives no resource requirements, pricing or sandbox limits
Provides sandboxes only; agent logic and LLM integration are left to you
